Each line must: - Be a short instruction, ≤ ~25 English words. - Use idiomatic English with dry, warm, domestic-detective humor (EN). - Use natural Korean localization — not a word-for-word translation (KO). - Remain appropriate for a cozy family game: no death, threats, gore, or menacing undertone. - Avoid inventing evidence, motives, facial tells, suspect guilt, or result-specific reactions. Additional per-stage copy constraints: - **listening**: must clearly state that the three official statements are the only evidence, using grammatically correct idiomatic English. - **confronting**: must explain that questioning an object causes another object to object; must direct the player to compare the two quoted official statements side by side and note findings. Must not use the phrase "Pin the gap" or imply every exchange proves a contradiction. - **deducing**: must explain that hypotheses can be crossed out and restored by tapping again, and that the final accusation is once only. Must not imply the player already knows the answer or that one remaining hypothesis is automatically correct. - **reveal**: must be worded identically regardless of whether the player's accusation was right or wrong. Must not reference success, failure, or a particular culprit. ### R3 — Deterministic accessor The module must export a function `getDetectiveVoice(stage, locale)` that returns the `StageCopy` for that pair. The function must be deterministic: the same inputs always return the same output. ` element with: - `className="detective-aside"` - `data-testid="detective-aside"` - `data-stage={stage}` (enables stage verification without parsing copy text) - `aria-label` set to the localized notebook title - The mascot image `/art/kirolock-homes.png` with: - `className="detective-aside-mascot"` - `alt=""` (decorative) - `aria-hidden="true"` - `width={72}` and `height={72}` (prevents layout shift; historical filename kept) - `decoding="async"` - A wrapper `
` containing: - A `` with the localized notebook title: - English: `"Kirock's notebook"` - Korean: `"킬록의 수첩"` - A `

` containing the stage copy line. ### R8 — No state, no network `DetectiveAside` must hold no local state and make no network requests. It is a pure function of its props. ### R9 — No forbidden component dependencies `DetectiveAside` must not import: - Server-only modules - AI modules - Solver, generator, renderer, or case-data modules - Any module that exposes the culprit identity, role assignment, or verdict ### R10 — Live region restraint The aside must not use `aria-live`, `role="status"`, or `role="alert"` unless integration evidence shows a specific need. Stage changes are driven by deliberate player navigation; a live region would announce unnecessarily. ### R11 — No inline styles that prevent responsive styling The component sets only `width` and `height` on the `` element. All other layout and visual treatment is delegated to Codex's CSS via the class names in R7. ### R12 — Styling and integration are Codex's responsibility Codex owns all CSS, the `game-invariants` steering scope, and `Game.tsx`. This spec does not define colors, sizes, placement, or responsive breakpoints. --- ## Out of scope - Codex-owned files (`Game.tsx`, CSS, existing components, server routes) - Prior Kiro-owned files (`hypothesis.ts`, `HypothesisBoard.tsx`, related specs) - Live AI copy generation during gameplay - Animation, sound, or transition behavior - Persistent storage of any kind - Tests that simply repeat the copy dictionary
